lines.t: Come, you who have never known my ways
I am here, I will guide your steps
Come, you're left alone in the cold
I will be your shelter
Your rest
Come, you broken, unable to stand
We will rise and run again
Come, you empty, dry within
Watch your cup overflow without end
Come now, love is calling your name
No soul too lost, no heart in vain. Take my hand, don't be afraid. All things live in the light I gave. Come now, just as you are from the shadows.
Near or far
Grace will meet you
Where you've been
Love awaits
Come enter in
Come enter in
Come, you burdened by your past
I will awaken what has died
Come, you who have spoken in darkness
I will give you the voice of life
Bring the ones who cannot see
Bring the ones who cannot hear
I will open blinded eyes
Let every silent soul draw near
Come now, love is calling your name
No soul too lost, no heart in vain
Take my hand, don't be afraid
All things live in the light I gave
Come now, just as you are
From the shadows, near or far
This will meet you where you've been
Love awaits
Come enter in
Come, though you have walked against me
Still, I reach for your hand
I will lead you to the water
Where your new life begins
Washed in streams of mercy flowing
Rows of light upon the trees
By the river of my promise
You are made completely free
Come, come on, come on
Don't delay
Ask in faith
I'll make a way
All is possible through my love
Given through the Son of God
Come now
Love is calling your name
The restored be made again
Step into what's always been true
Love awaits you
Love awaits you
